settings.title: Orders
settings.language.title: Tongue
settings.language.subtitle: Choose the tongue used by Jade ship UI.
settings.language.description: Only Jade interface text is translated. Filenames, tab names, champion names, game assets, scroll contents, and paths stay exactly as they are.
settings.language.restartNote: Most labels patch the hull immediately. A few system dialogs or already-unfurl status messages may patch the hull after reopenin' the surface.
settings.language.voiceDescription: Joke English rewrites of the UI. Pickin' one switches the tongue about-face to English.
settings.behavior.title: Ship Habits
settings.behavior.subtitle: Control how Jade behaves on yer system.
settings.behavior.renderGameMaterialsDes: Render champion and map materials through the game's own compiled shaders (auto-translated to the crow's nest) for a closer-to-in-game look. Still a work in progress - expect minor visual issues. Takes effect when an object loads or its mesh is refreshed.
settings.behavior.minimizeToTrayDesc: Keep Jade runnin' in the system tray when the porthole is minimized.
settings.behavior.runAtStartupDesc: Launch Jade automatically when Windows starts.
settings.behavior.communicateQuartzDesc: Allow Jade and Quartz to exchange unfurl/reload/patch the hull messages. Disable this to fully stop interop communication.
settings.behavior.externalDiff: Flash a diff when another ship changes a scroll
settings.behavior.externalDiffDesc: When something outside Jade rewrites a scroll ye have unfurl - Quartz, ritobin, a text scribe, a second Jade porthole - unfurl a diff tab so ye can accept or reject the swap instead of having it applied silently.
settings.behavior.fileHistoryDesc: Remembers each scroll's earlier states independently of the scribe, so Ctrl+Z still works after a tab is closed and reopened, after many tabs push it out of memory, and about-face past changes another ship made to the scroll. Belay that only affects the scribe - stash to write it to disk.
settings.behavior.fileHistoryStepsDesc: How many earlier states Jade keeps per scroll. These are whole revisions - an outside swap, a stash, a hold fast in yer typing - not individual keystrokes; the scribe's own belay that handles those and isn't limited. States are stored as differences rather than full copies, so a high number costs little on ordinary edits, and Jade keeps a memory ceilin' underneath this so a handful of very large bins can't run away with it.
settings.behavior.recentFilesDesc: How many recently-unfurled scrolls Jade keeps in the Start screen list. History on disk is preserved up to 100 entries - bumpin' this about-face up restores older items.
settings.behavior.materialOverrideDesc: Controls how Auto from SKN matches materials to textures.
settings.registration.title: Scroll Registration
settings.registration.subtitle: Manage how Windows treats Jade-supported scroll types.
settings.registration.fileAssociationDes: Register Jade as the default handler for .bin scrolls.
settings.registration.success: Jade is registered as the .bin scroll handler.
settings.performance.title: Performance
settings.performance.subtitle: Scribe features have a cost on huge bin dumps. Each option below can be kept on, automatically dropped on big scrolls (over 125,000 lines), or always off.
settings.updates.title: Updates
settings.updates.subtitle: Keep Jade up to date with the latest features and fixes.
settings.updates.startupPopupDesc: A native popup shown while Jade launches - it applies any ship or hash patch the hull and covers the hoist. Classic is a plain Windows-style porthole; Modern is the dark styled one.
settings.updates.appInterval: Ship patch the hull spy interval
settings.updates.appIntervalDesc: How often the launcher checks GitHub for a new Jade version at startup. Hash updates have their own schedule in the Hash Scrolls section.
settings.hashes.downloadingLmdb: Downloadin' combined LMDB hashes from lmdb-hashes...
settings.hashes.title: Hash Scrolls
settings.hashes.subtitle: Hash scrolls convert hex values into readable names.
settings.hashes.lmdbTitle: Pulls lol-hashes-combined.zst from lmdb-hashes releases. ~50 MB, shared with Quartz.
settings.hashes.textTitle: Pulls the legacy CommunityDragon text scrolls. Used as a fallback when LMDB isn't available.
settings.hashes.activeSourcesDesc: Jade reads BIN hashes from the text scrolls and WAD hashes from the local database.
settings.hashes.textRamDesc: Text scroll hashes. Hoisted into memory once at startup.
settings.hashes.lmdbDesc: Read hashes from the local database on demand, shared with Quartz.
settings.hashes.updateScheduleDesc: How often the startup launcher refreshes hash scrolls (WAD paths + BIN names) before Jade opens.
settings.hashes.everyLaunchDesc: The launcher compares the release fingerprint each launch. Re-downloads only when a new lmdb-hashes release is published.
settings.hashes.every3DaysDesc: Same fingerprint spy, throttled to once every three days. Less network traffic.
settings.hashes.every7DaysDesc: Same fingerprint spy, throttled to once a week. Least network traffic.
settings.library.subtitle: Manage downloaded materials and how Jade keeps them up to date.
settings.library.updateModeDesc: When should Jade spy for new and updated materials?
settings.library.timedIntervalDesc: Periodically spy on a fixed schedule while Jade is runnin'.
settings.library.smartCheckDesc: On launch, fetch only the index and only recast materials if the repo's lastUpdated is newer than yer cache.
settings.library.everyLaunchDesc: Always recast outdated materials in the background at startup. Most aggressive - most network traffic.
settings.performance.minimapDesc: Thumbnail of the whole scroll on the right edge. Has to render every line on each swap - biggest cost on huge scrolls.
settings.performance.bracketColorsDesc: Colors matchin' brackets so structure is easier to scan. Re-walks the bracket tree on every edit.
settings.performance.occurrencesHighligh: Highlights other instances of the symbol under the cursor. Scans the document on cursor moves.
settings.performance.selectionHighlightD: Highlights other matches of the current selection. Same scan cost as occurrence highlightin'.
settings.performance.lineHighlightDesc: Tints the row the caret is on across the full scribe width. Restrict to the gutter to skip the full-width paint.
settings.performance.foldingDesc: Lets ye collapse blocks. Foldin' analyzes structure on every swap.
settings.performance.stopRenderingLineDe: When off, Monaco stops renderin' past column 10,000 on a line - invisible for normal lines, big aid on lines with long string values.
settings.modchecker.title: Mod Checker
settings.modchecker.subtitle: Choose which content checks the Manage tab runs and how fixes are offered. Reference checks always run; these control the extra content-validity checks on top.
settings.modchecker.samplerDesc: Flag materials whose sampler keys are scrambled so the model renders untextured white, and offer a one-tap re-key.
settings.modchecker.staleDesc: Flag leftover ContextualAction / AnimationGraph / GearSkinUpgrade objects that nothing references, and offer to drop them.
settings.modchecker.gameplayDesc: Point out bins that swap abilities, spells, stats or recommendations instead of visuals, so ye can drop them if ye only want the skin.
settings.modchecker.textureDimsDesc: Flag textures whose width or height isn't a multiple of 4 and offer to crop them to a safe size.
settings.modchecker.confidentFixesDesc: Flash the button that applies every high-confidence, low-risk fix at once. Turn off to review and make it so each fix individually.
settings.modchecker.riskyFixesDesc: Flash medium- and high-risk findings. Turn off to see only the safe, low-risk fixes.
settings.behavior.matchExact: Exact - material name must match texture filename exactly (e.g. Body -> Body.tex).
settings.behavior.matchLoose: Loose - strips trailin' numbers and checks partial containment (e.g. Body2 -> Body.tex).
settings.behavior.matchFuzzy: Fuzzy - picks the closest texture by character overlap. May produce inaccurate matches.

patch.noNotes: This release was published without any notes.

Any unsaved work should be stashed first.
preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Configure yer experience
preferences.importLinkedBinsDesc: When enabled, openin' a bin scroll will automatically unfurl all linked bin scrolls found in the DATA chest.
preferences.recursiveLinkedBins: Also hoist scrolls linked inside imported scrolls
preferences.recursiveLinkedBinsDesc: Recursively opens linked scrolls from within the imported linked scrolls (may unfurl many tabs).
preferences.emitterHintsDesc: Displays emitter names inline onward to collapsed VfxEmitterDefinitionData blocks in the scribe.
preferences.syntaxCheckingDesc: Highlights lines with syntax errors (such as mismatched or unclosed brackets) in the scribe in real time.
preferences.championNames: Flash Champion Names on Bin Tabs
preferences.championNamesDesc: Labels a character bin's tab with the champion it belongs to - "Jinx/Skin0.bin" instead of "Skin0.bin", so a row of unfurl skins is tellable apart. Those tabs get a little wider. Bins with nay champion in them (maps, items) are left as they are.
preferences.blendKeysDesc: Shows mBlendDataTable keys as "Attack1" -> "Laugh" instead of the packed number they are stored as. Applies to scrolls unfurled after the swap, and only on the Jade Custom converter engine. The text is easier to edit but is nay longer standard ritobin, so other gear won't read it about-face - Jade always accepts both spellings, and saving to .bin produces the same bytes either way.
preferences.textureEditorDesc: Ship used when clickin' "Edit Image" on a texture peek. Grayed-out options were not detected on this machine.

extract.settings.gameLocationDesc: Where the "League of Legends" shortcut in the Locations list points. Jade finds this on its own from the Riot Client install records, fallin' about-face to a sweep of every drive. Set it by hand if that comes up barren or lands on the wrong install - pick the install chest and Jade will step into its Game\DATA\FINAL for ye.
extract.settings.usingFolder: Using yer chest. Swab it to go about-face to auto-detection.
extract.settings.autoNone: Auto-detection found nothing on this machine.
extract.settings.outputLayoutDesc: Whether extracted scrolls keep the WAD's chest tree or land directly in the target.
extract.settings.preserveStructureDesc: Recreate the WAD's full directory tree on disk - the default Quartz-style layout.
extract.settings.flatDesc: Drop every extracted scroll straight into the target chest with nay sub-directories. Best when pickin' just one or two scrolls. Scrolls with the same name overwrite each other.
extract.settings.makeWadFolderDesc: Nest the structure under a chest named after the WAD, e.g. aatrox/assets/.... Disable to plunder the WAD's top-level chests straight into the target. Only applies when preservin' structure.
extract.settings.defaultLocationDesc: Skip the "pick a chest" dialog and plunder straight to a fixed location. Defaults to Documents/Jade Exports.
extract.settings.fastOverwriteDesc: Writes each chunk to a temp scroll (.jdtmp) then atomically renames it over the target. Re-extracts into a populated chest finish in roughly the same time as a fresh plunder. Disable for a classic in-place overwrite.
extract.settings.autoCheckDesc: Clickin' a scroll inside a WAD adds it to the plunder queue, and clickin' a queued scroll removes it. Disable to require checkbox clicks.
extract.settings.repathPrefixDesc: When the Re-course checkbox is on, this chest name gets inserted directly under assets/ and data/ in the extracted tree. BIN strings are rewritten in lockstep so the resultin' mod stays consistent.

themes.noDescription: Nay description yet for this flag.
themes.modernOffNote: Applyin' this flag will toggle Modern UI off.

themes.effectsWelcomeTitle: Set sail effects on the welcome screen.
themes.effectsSubtitle: Alternate themes carry a lightweight animated effect on the porthole background. Leave Override off to follow the current flag, or turn it on to pick yer own.
themes.effectsModernOnly: Effects only render with Modern UI enabled - the peek below still shows them.
themes.backgroundSubtitle: Use yer own image behind the ship. When enabled, top ribbons and bars switch to neutral glass.
themes.backgroundEmpty: Scroll to zoom, drag to position
themes.workspaceSubtitle: Choose how the ship is organized: title bar, tab strip, menus or ribbon, and where tool panels dock. Switchin' takes effect right away.
themes.documentTitle: Very unfinished - Classic or Studio recommended
themes.classicDesc: The original Jade layout. Tabs across the top, a menu bar with Scroll / Edit / Gear, and floatin' popovers for Hunt, Swap, General Editin', and Particle Editin'.
themes.studioDesc: Menu bar plus a quick action toolbar. Tool windows dock to the sides and bottom of the scribe with resizable splits, and they remember their position between sessions.
themes.documentDesc: A Word-style ribbon layout - title bar with Stash / Belay that / Again ye dogs, a tabs dropdown in place of the tab strip, and a ribbon for Home / Tuck in / View / Aid. Very unfinished. For day-to-day work use Classic or Studio.
themes.displaySubtitle: Control the visual style of the ship.
themes.roundedCornersDesc: Make it so rounded corners to panels and buttons
themes.imageTooLarge: Pray choose an image smaller than 8 MB.
themes.readImageFailed: Went under to read image data.
themes.loadImageFailed: Went under to hoist image scroll.
themes.selectFontFile: Pray claim a TTF, OTF, WOFF, or WOFF2 font scroll.
themeDesc.Default: Discover the once great city of the Archangel's home planet, Avaria. Their presence has long since passed and the Constructs, mimickin' the fallen, have taken over. Avenge the fallen.
themeDesc.DarkBlue: Deep water, quiet tool. A harbor palette ideal for long nights and rough days.
themeDesc.DarkRed: A creation of pure emotion. Work with muted crimson red and enjoy this side of the color wheel.
themeDesc.Sakura: Petals fall past the scribe. Soft pink glass and spring air, a reminder that life is sometimes pink.(what?)
themeDesc.Frost: Ice gradiented UI. Pale cyan light, allows the modern UI for those who want to use the modern layout but also want a light flag.
themeDesc.Forest: Moss on stone, fireflies after dusk. A quiet hillside where the only sound is yer keyboard and the wind in the needles.
themeDesc.AMOLED: True black. Lighter white and nay contrast highlights, made for OLED screens and people who hate wastin' light.
themeDesc.Light: Nostalgic Office look, white paper with blue ink for the 2009 program vibe.
themeDesc.HighContrast: Pure Black and White. Yellow highlights. It has edges around all elements for the complete High Contrast experience.
themeDesc.Grok: Pure black canvas, silver chrome, blue highlights. The X timeline aesthetic, tuned for Jade instead of posts.
themeDesc.DeepSpace: "The void does not hate ye. It simply has better things to look at." Violet dark between stars, spaceyyy.
themeDesc.Orchid: A folded up piece of paper with an orchid left in the rain. Deeper purple like an orchid and a light rain effect.
themeDesc.Autumn: October soon, it's orange. There's fire embers effect coming from the ground. Maybe they feel warm.
themeDesc.StormySea: Thunder over dark water. The deck is wet, the horizon is wrong, and somehow the ship sails.(u can disable rain in the effects menu)
themeDesc.Cyberpunk2077: Neon acid on night glass. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.BladeRunner2049: Red sky, steel will. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.YoRHa: Glory to mankind. Sand, steel, and a title bar that still pretends the war is going well. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.Lain: Present day. Present time. Pink static on black glass. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.MilkBag: "A billion pounds of concrete and a million miles of emptiness. It is impossible to stay sane when ye be near cosmic numbers like that, lookin' at them, touchin' them. Even thinkin' of them makes me feel unimaginable horror."
effectDesc.stars: Slowly driftin', twinklin' stars - a lightweight imitation of deep space.
effectDesc.petals: Cherry-blossom petals driftin' down with a gentle sway.
effectDesc.snow: Soft frost motes fallin' slowly across the porthole.
effectDesc.fireflies: Fireflies wanderin' and pulsin' in the dark.
effectDesc.storm: Heavy wind-driven rain - a stormier, more aggressive downpour.
effectDesc.embers: Embers and sparks rising and flickerin' from below.
effectDesc.rain: Soft rainfall streakin' down the porthole.

settings.language.status.en: Jade is developed in English. This tongue is fully supported.
settings.language.status.sr: This tongue was translated with AI using Jade's real UI context, and worded to match Windows and Riot terminology so it feels familiar.
settings.language.status.machine: This tongue is a raw Google Translate. Jade stays usable, but some wordin' will sound off or miss ship context. If ye want to contribute better wordin', take the locale scrolls from GitHub or contact the developer through the About menu.
settings.language.status.fun: This be a fun voice pack. Jade stays usable; only the wordin' is silly.

model.spellFormTitle: Spy the skin with every buff-rigged material driver lit (e.g. Viego in his E mist)
model.repathWadFoldersTitle: Shove a prefix folder under assets/ and data/ (set in Extraction Settings → Repath prefix). BIN strings get rewritten in lockstep so the mod still loads.
model.mergeLinkedBinsTitle: Fold every linked dependency BIN into the primary skin BIN — the mod ships with one consolidated BIN instead of a chain of linked files. The champion's gameplay BIN is never merged.
model.preserveHudIconsTitle: On: include every assets/characters/<champ>/hud/icons2d/ file and keep BIN refs canonical (no repath). Off: skip HUD icons entirely — they aren't extracted and the game falls back to Riot's installed icons.
model.skipSfxVoTitle: On: skip SFX/VO files entirely — assets/sounds/ and assets/audio/ are NOT extracted, BIN refs stay canonical, game uses Riot's installed audio. Off: include audio files and repath them along with the rest of the mod.
model.exportVoTitle: On: open the sibling locale VO WAD (e.g. Akali.en_US.wad.client) and pull this skin's voiceover .wpk / .bnk files into the main extracted folder. BIN VO refs get repathed alongside them when repath is on.
